name: Analyze Cas9 Mutation Outcomes
description: Analyzes and categorizes mutations induced by Cas9 at target sites.
detailed_description: Analyzes and categorizes mutations induced by Cas9 at target sites.
when_to_use: When you need analyze cas9 mutation outcomes analysis

parameters.reference_sequences: [Required] Dictionary mapping sequence IDs to reference DNA sequences (strings) (dict)
parameters.edited_sequences: [Required] Nested dictionary: {sequence_id: {read_id: sequence}} containing the edited/mutated sequences for each reference (dict)
parameters.cell_line_info: [Optional] Dictionary mapping sequence IDs to cell line information (e.g., wildtype, knockout gene)
